image_description: A close-up, slightly low-resolution image of a vintage-style aneroid barometer. The instrument features a circular dial with a metallic (likely brass) bezel and a dark brown casing or backing. The face is white with black markings, including a scale and text, and two pointer hands (one black, one likely gold/brass). The background is a solid, bright blue gradient.

The central pivot point of the hands is slightly muddy and lacks the crisp mechanical definition expected of a real device, blending slightly with the hands.
